title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Halal Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish made with halal spices, snapper, and a hint of flame. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: Halal spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and pepper.
Brush the grill with a small amount of oil to prevent sticking.
Add the snapper fillets to the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the halal spices in a small bowl.
Once the snapper is cooked, brush the halal spice mixture evenly over the top of each fillet.
Serve immediately with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with additional halal spices, if desired.
